definition: The proportion of actual positive cases that a model correctly identifies.
details: Recall (also called sensitivity) is critical in settings where missing a positive case is costly, such as disease detection or fraud detection.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Recall.
